recognize_zh: 大量顆粒球系細胞呈連續成熟譜系，骨髓細胞、後骨髓細胞、帶狀及分葉核中性球都有，並夾雜數顆較大、染色質細緻、細胞質嗜鹼性的早期細胞；左移明顯，需計數母細胞才能分期。
features: Numerous granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation
Myelocytes and metamyelocytes with round to indented nuclei and gray-pink granular cytoplasm
Several larger immature cells (promyelocytes/blasts) with finer chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm
Bands and segmented neutrophils without obvious dysplasia
Basophils not clearly identified in this field; few red cells in background
describe_en: The smear shows a prominent granulocytic population spanning myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils, with several larger immature cells having finer chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm. Dysgranulopoiesis is not evident. Basophils are not clearly identified in this field, and the proportion of blasts cannot be established without a differential count. Findings are compatible with CML showing marked left shift; accelerated phase requires quantitative criteria.

ddx.vs: Chronic and accelerated phase share this morphology; blasts 10-19%, basophils >=20%, persistent thrombocytopenia or additional clonal abnormalities define accelerated phase.
Reactive granulocytosis shows toxic granulation, fewer myelocytes and no basophilia, and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
aCML shows prominent dysgranulopoiesis and is BCR::ABL1-negative.
